boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Emmanuel College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food runs around Fenway, Longwood, Back Bay, Kenmore, and greater Boston, each verified through a current direct business page showing service at 11 p.m. or later.

cards.title: Burgers Until 2
cards.subtitle: 86 Van Ness Street in Fenway
cards.notes: Head toward Van Ness Street for burgers, hot dogs, fries, or shakes; confirm the posted schedule before making a late trip.
cards.short_summary: A Fenway counter-service option with the latest daily closing time in the immediate campus area.
cards.evidence_claim: Tasty Burger’s official Fenway page lists 86 Van Ness Street and daily hours of 11 a.m.–2 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently lists service until 2 a.m. seven days a week; check for holiday or event-day changes.

cards.title: The Huntington Avenue Burrito Run
cards.subtitle: 269 Huntington Avenue near Symphony
cards.notes: Follow Huntington Avenue toward Symphony for tacos, burritos, or bowls, and use the official ordering link to check availability.
cards.short_summary: A close-to-campus taqueria whose published schedule extends well beyond midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: El Jefe’s official site identifies its Symphony location at 269 Huntington Avenue and lists it open daily from 8 a.m. to 3 a.m.
cards.source_title: El Jefe's Taqueria | Authentic Mexican Food. Open Til 4AM.
cards.access_notes: The official site currently lists the Symphony shop as open seven days a week until 3 a.m.; verify before departure.

cards.title: A Kenmore Square Taco Stop
cards.subtitle: 533 Commonwealth Avenue in Kenmore Square
cards.notes: Pair a Kenmore errand with a taco or bowl order, keeping to well-lit main streets and checking the live order page first.
cards.short_summary: A named Kenmore Square destination with food service published through 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: El Jefe’s official site identifies its Kenmore Square location at 533 Commonwealth Avenue and lists hours of 8 a.m.–3 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: El Jefe's Taqueria | Authentic Mexican Food. Open Til 4AM.
cards.access_notes: The business currently publishes a 3 a.m. closing time for Kenmore Square every day; recheck current service before traveling.

cards.title: Midnight on Boylston
cards.subtitle: 755 Boylston Street in Back Bay
cards.notes: Use the Boylston Street location for a straightforward chicken-finger pickup; review the official page before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A Back Bay counter-service destination with dine-in hours extending to midnight every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s official location page lists 755 Boylston Street and operating and dine-in hours of 10 a.m.–midnight daily.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's in Boston, MA - 755 Boylston Street
cards.access_notes: Official operating and dine-in schedules currently run until midnight every day; holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: Chicken Fingers Before 11
cards.subtitle: 949 Commonwealth Avenue by Boston University
cards.notes: Save this Commonwealth Avenue counter for an earlier late-night run, since its posted closing time is 11 p.m. nightly.
cards.short_summary: A university-area fast-food stop with a consistent published 11 p.m. closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s official page identifies the Boston University restaurant at 949 Commonwealth Avenue and lists 10 a.m.–11 p.m. hours daily.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's in Boston, MA - 949 Commonwealth Ave
cards.access_notes: The official page currently lists both operating and dine-in hours through 11 p.m. seven days a week.

cards.title: Mediterranean Food at Midnight
cards.subtitle: 100 Peterborough Street in Fenway
cards.notes: Walk toward Peterborough Street for Mediterranean dishes, then verify the kitchen is accepting orders near closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Fenway restaurant publishing a midnight close throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Fenway Grill & Bar’s official site lists its address as 100 Peterborough Street and its hours as 10 a.m.–midnight Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Fenway Grill & Bar | Turkish & Mediterranean Restaurant in Boston
cards.access_notes: The restaurant currently posts midnight closing every day; contact it directly to confirm how late food orders are accepted.

cards.title: Donuts After Dark
cards.subtitle: Walk-up window at 1 Lansdowne Street
cards.notes: Look for the walk-up side door on Ipswich Street after 7 p.m.; order ahead if available and confirm the pop-up schedule.
cards.short_summary: An evening-only Fenway doughnut window whose entire published schedule runs from 7 p.m. to 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Back Door Donuts’ official Boston page lists the pop-up at 1 Lansdowne Street and states that it is open daily from 7 p.m. to 2 a.m.
cards.source_title: Hours & Location | Back Door Donuts Boston Pop-Up
cards.access_notes: The official page currently lists daily walk-up service from 7 p.m. to 2 a.m.; the counter operates from a side door.

cards.title: A Round-the-Clock Bakery Counter
cards.subtitle: 134 Salem Street in the North End
cards.notes: Make this a planned cross-city bakery trip, use established transit or a rideshare late at night, and travel with company.
cards.short_summary: A North End bakery offering pastries, breads, pizza, and sandwiches around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Bova’s official site lists the bakery at 134 Salem Street and states that it is open 24 hours a day, every day.
cards.access_notes: The bakery’s official site currently states that it operates 24 hours a day, every day; plan safe transportation from campus.

cards.title: Breakfast at Any Hour
cards.subtitle: 178 Kneeland Street near South Station
cards.notes: Treat this as a deliberate cross-city diner run, travel with others after midnight, and confirm service before leaving Fenway.
cards.short_summary: A classic diner serving breakfast and dinner through every overnight hour.
cards.evidence_claim: South Street Diner’s official late-night page lists 178 Kneeland Street and explicitly states that the restaurant is open 24/7.
cards.source_title: Boston's Only Late Night Eats | South Street Diner
cards.access_notes: The official page explicitly lists the diner as open at midnight through 6 a.m. and says it is open 24/7.

cards.title: Commonwealth Avenue Until 3
cards.subtitle: 957 Commonwealth Avenue by Boston University
cards.notes: Use this farther Commonwealth Avenue shop for a planned late pickup, checking transit and the live order page before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A Boston University-area taqueria with a daily schedule extending to 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: El Jefe’s official site identifies its Boston University shop at 957 Commonwealth Avenue and lists daily hours of 8 a.m.–3 a.m.
cards.source_title: El Jefe's Taqueria | Authentic Mexican Food. Open Til 4AM.
cards.access_notes: The official site currently lists the Boston University location as open seven days a week until 3 a.m.; verify before traveling.
